name: cv.cm
description: Free browser tools. Image, PDF, audio and AI tools process files on the user's device and never upload them. Each tool's data_handling says what happens to its input; Cloud clipboard stores data on cv.cm.
ai_backend_note: The page uses WebGPU with 16-bit floats when the GPU supports them (webgpu_fp16), WebGPU otherwise (webgpu), and WebAssembly on the CPU without WebGPU (cpu). Sizes are model weights; the first AI tool used also loads the ONNX Runtime WebAssembly engine (tens of MB, cached). If a WebGPU run fails, the page retries on the CPU, which also downloads the cpu weights when they are a different file.

categories.name: Precious metals, oil and stock calculators (unit and ratio math; the user enters any prices, no live quotes)

tools.name: Cloud clipboard
tools.description: Pastebin-style notes: text, images, files.
tools.data_handling: Stores the note on cv.cm (text in its database, files on its storage host s3.cv.cm) until 10 views or 24 hours. Anyone with the short link can open it, so it is not for secrets.

ai.options: Background: Transparent / White / Color / Blur. Format: PNG / JPG / WebP (PNG and WebP keep transparency; JPG has none, so a transparent background exports as white. tools.name: Speech to text
tools.description: Transcribe audio and video with Whisper. TXT, SRT and VTT.
tools.data_handling: Downloads an AI model once and runs it on the device. Files are not uploaded.

ai.options: Model: "Fast" or "Accurate" (better for Chinese, Japanese and Korean); the default is "Accurate" on a GPU with 16-bit float support and "Fast" otherwise. Spoken language: Detect automatically or a chosen language. Output: Same language / Translate to English. Chinese characters (shown only for Chinese audio with "Same language"): 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / As written. Export TXT, SRT or VTT. Records from the microphone too. Accepts MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, Opus, FLAC, WebM, MP4, MOV and MKV.
